categories.main_business_segments: CEC Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in ecological environment governance, focusing on three main segments: water treatment (including industrial water treatment and urban sewage and water environment governance), solid and hazardous waste treatment (including sludge coupling treatment, soil remediation, kitchen waste treatment, hazardous waste disposal), and flue gas treatment (including desulfurization, denitrification, dust removal, VOCs treatment). Additionally, the company develops high-end equipment manufacturing and smart environmental protection solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technologies such as zero discharge wastewater treatment combined with nanofiltration membrane separation, full membrane water treatment processes, distributed smart water body purification modules (CBS), and sludge drying coupling treatment technology. It also develops integrated flue gas treatment technologies including CCFB semi-dry desulfurization, limestone-gypsum and ammonia desulfurization, SCR and SNCR denitrification, and dry calcium-based desulfurization (CEEP-HLDI) and HTR-3SO denitrification technologies. The company emphasizes R&D in membrane technology, chemical crystallization softening, lithium extraction from salt lakes, and intelligent monitoring systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CEC Environmental Protection serves key industrial sectors such as power generation (including nuclear, thermal, and renewable energy), petrochemical, metallurgy, coal chemical, coal mining, new energy, and building materials. It also serves municipal and industrial park clients for urban sewage treatment and water environment projects. The company’s customers include major national industrial enterprises and extend to overseas markets in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, especially Belt and Road countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive projects across multiple provinces and cities including Jiangsu, Henan, Ningxia, Guangdong, Shandong, and others. It also has international operations in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, focusing on Belt and Road countries. The majority of revenue is domestic (over 98%), with a small portion from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: CEC Environmental Protection operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It provides integrated solutions including R&D, core equipment manufacturing, system integration, engineering contracting (EPC/EP), facility operation and maintenance, and project investment. The company is a system solution provider and project operator rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in zero discharge wastewater treatment, membrane separation technologies, sludge drying coupling, and smart environmental monitoring. It actively pursues R&D in lithium extraction from salt lakes, chemical crystallization softening, and intelligent water quality monitoring systems. The strategic focus includes expanding digital and smart environmental protection platforms, enhancing technology transfer and industrialization through innovation platforms, and supporting carbon neutrality goals through energy-efficient and low-carbon technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering contracting (EPC, EP), project investment and operation (BOT, EPCO), equipment manufacturing and sales, and provision of environmental protection services including facility operation and maintenance. The company also earns income from technology licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns from affiliated entities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CEC Environmental Protection is a leading player in China’s ecological environment governance industry, holding a top market position in nuclear and thermal power water treatment and sludge coupling treatment. It competes with other national environmental protection firms in water treatment, solid waste, and flue gas treatment sectors. The company leverages its comprehensive service capabilities, proprietary technologies, and innovation platforms to maintain competitive advantages in specialized market segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.006 billion, a slight decrease of 1.7% from the previous year, while net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 12.55% to RMB 85.8 million. Total assets were about RMB 2.89 billion with net assets of RMB 1.83 billion. The company maintains steady growth with a return on equity of 4.77% and continues to invest in R&D and innovation platforms to support future expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CEC Environmental Protection emphasizes its integrated ecological environment governance solutions combining advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive service capabilities from design to operation, and strong innovation platforms. Its unique value lies in zero discharge wastewater treatment, membrane technology, sludge drying coupling, and smart environmental monitoring systems. The company’s ability to provide full lifecycle services and its leadership in specialized industrial water treatment and sludge treatment markets differentiate it from competitors.
